title: Initial held-out pass and analysis verdicts (BASE), block composite
population: BASE (iteration-0 artifacts of the base cells); E01/E04: ENH_PAIRS(BASE)
notes: Cells: percentage (numerator/denominator); E01 and E04 count enhanced pairs, E02/F01/F02 base cells; F01/F02 DIRTY = >= 1 reported blocking finding of an applicable tool (union over tools, labelled as such).
Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): no unit is excluded in this table by E02 (artifact(s) without a valid pair (counted separately)).
BL01: Includes dense_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.
REASONING: Reasoning settings differ between models and are not equalised (see the closure disclosure register, item reasoning_policy_differences); some providers report no reasoning-token field.

IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01.

IC4: DIRTY means at least one finding the frozen tool configuration marks blocking (dominated by clang-tidy bugprone heuristics, see X03), not a confirmed defect; under the frozen rule findings of entries in analysis-gap states count (sensitivity X02).

definitions.text: BASE: the 1,980 base cells (pilot_002 396 + full_ext_001 1,584), iteration-0 artifacts (use: initial code quality)
ENH_PAIRS: the enhanced pairs of the artifacts of a population; VALID pairs = status not in GATED (use: held-out evaluation)
E01 enhanced_pair_pass: numerator = valid pairs with status pass; denominator = valid pairs; unit = enhanced pair (inference: benchmark cluster).
E02 enhanced_all_pass: numerator = artifacts with >= 1 valid pair and every valid pair pass; denominator = artifacts with >= 1 valid pair; unit = artifact.
E04 enhanced_gated_share: numerator = gated pairs; denominator = all pairs; unit = enhanced pair.
F01 static_verdict_three_state: numerator = artifacts per state; denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact.
F02 dynamic_verdict_three_state: numerator = artifacts per state; denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact.

ci_note: 95% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted)

footnotes.text: --: not estimated at this stratification (the producer computes F01/F02 per model and per execution model, not per model x execution model)
